channel.title: Ted’s Stories | Ted Johnson Works
channel.description: Practical articles, personal stories, and lessons from Ted Johnson’s work and life.

item.title: Congratulations! I've Just Protected You From Yourself!
item.description: Ted Johnson’s phone-number and Apple Card experience, modern authentication, accessible account recovery and practical help when digital services fail.

item.title: The Cheese Moved. So Did Ted.
item.description: Ted Johnson’s return to work and research on older Americans’ finances, physical demands, well-being and connection. Practical understanding across generations.

item.title: Moving at the FREEZE of Business
item.description: Why security delays protect bank accounts, and why secure account recovery should still respect people.

item.title: Is Your Face the New Password?
item.description: An accessible look at face recognition, passkeys, bodily change, and the human right to secure account recovery.

item.title: How Many Passwords Does One Human Need?
item.description: A practical, research-backed guide to password overload, password managers, passkeys, and account recovery.

item.title: Life Savings Gone. Here's Your Identity Monitoring Subscription.
item.description: Evidence on elder fraud, monitoring limits, real-time intervention, and what to do immediately after a scam.

item.title: AI for People Who Don’t Want to Become AI Experts
item.description: A plain-English approach to using AI for useful everyday work without hype, jargon, or pretending the tool is always right.

item.title: How I Built TedJohnsonWorks.com Without Hiring an Agency
item.description: A practical look at the stack and decisions behind TedJohnsonWorks.com: ChatGPT, GitHub, Astro, GitHub Actions, and Hostinger.

item.title: How I Keep TedJohnsonWorks.com Running Without Babysitting It
item.description: How Ted Johnson keeps TedJohnsonWorks.com running with one source of truth, an automated GitHub deployment path, and Hostinger publishing the approved production branch.

item.title: How I Use Payhip to Sell Practical Guides
item.description: A practical look at using Payhip for digital guides and direct services without building a full ecommerce system from scratch.

item.title: Working Under Chef Al Hynes at the Belleview-Biltmore
item.description: Ted Johnson remembers learning pastry and hotel-kitchen discipline under Chef Al Hynes at Florida's Belleview-Biltmore, including one unusual day serving Secret Service personnel during the George H. W. Bush vice-presidential years.
